info.title: Task Manager — Frontend API / taskover.ir
info.description: Current /api/v1 route inventory and FormRequest validation for TaskOver. Includes meeting-scoped active chairman/secretary access, allowed_actions.complete, report-to-task integration and versioned attendee signatures. This revision must be deployed together with the matching frontend; calendar display is Persian while API dates stay Gregorian ISO. Existing administrator and independent task/report permissions are preserved. Contextual validation and authorization remain server-enforced; legacy resource examples are illustrative.

post.summary: Change the authenticated user's own password
post.description: Requires an active authenticated user, not a users:reset_password permission. Validates current_password, changes only the authenticated account, revokes other API tokens and outstanding OTPs, and retains the current bearer token. Rate limited to 5 requests/minute per user and 20/minute per IP. No user ID or identifier is accepted as a target.

password.description: Must differ from current_password, contain a letter, number and symbol, and be at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

200.description: Password updated; current bearer token remains valid.

post.summary: Create a task from a viewed report
post.description: Only active primary recipient of viewed report, including for super-admin. Calls existing TaskService.create inside report-row-locked transaction, reauthorizes locked source. Multiple tasks per report via new keys. Same key plus same validated payload returns existing current task with 200/replayed=true; changed payload returns 409. Hash ignores associative key ordering, preserves list order and JSON value types. Replays recheck current authorization/state and validation. Missing draft title/short_description/request_description default from report, short description clipped to 100 characters; custom values override. For submit=true, explicitly submit mandatory task fields (suggestions available on report). Existing task deletion rules remain: deleting a draft also removes its key; do not retry a deleted creation key, use a fresh key for a deliberate replacement.

tasks_url.description: Relative paginated relationship URL; null without tasks:view.

signed_at.description: Timestamp for CURRENT content only. Null for unsigned/outdated. Convert ISO UTC to Asia/Tehran for display.

signed_content_version.description: Signed content hash; may refer to an older version when status=outdated.

can_sign.description: True only for the current authenticated attendee, completed meeting, meetings:view permission and no signature for current content.

manage_resolutions.description: Scheduled meeting AND MeetingPolicy.manageResolutions. Active chairman/secretary of this meeting do not need global meetings:manage_resolutions. Existing authorized managers retain their access.

complete.description: Scheduled meeting, at least one resolution and MeetingPolicy.complete. Active chairman/secretary of this meeting do not need global meetings:complete.

report_source.description: Source report metadata, only if the actor may view that report. Null for unrelated tasks or inaccessible source. Source FK cannot be set/changed by task payloads.

submission_key.description: Required fresh UUID for each intended new task. Reuse unchanged key/body for transport retries. Scope is report + authenticated creator; uppercase UUID normalized to lowercase.

CreateReportTaskInput.description: Exact StoreTaskRequest rules plus submission_key UUID. source_report_id, report_submission_key and report_request_hash are prohibited, not client-writable. submit=true requires explicit title, short_description, duration_minutes and due_date; request additionally needs assignees/tags/followers/supervisors. Assignment assignee/requester is actor only. Request targets follow existing organization rules. Initial assignment planning progress stays zero. Attachments must be eligible files owned by actor (existing super-admin exception); report attachments/tags are not silently copied.

reports.activation: Deactivation preserves exact previous status and timestamps. Inactive reports allow reads and authorized report deletion, but no edits/send/view marking/comment mutations/reactions/mention lookup. Activation needs a stored known previous state; legacy unknown state returns409. Linked report edit/delete still requires scheduled meeting; send/activation/comments retain existing meeting-state rules.
